intent: Implement the accepted BeGood quality foundation and private narrative planning pilot: current principal/tenant checks, atomic quota and jobs, complete provider payload/schema/source gates, scoped persistence, bounded private reviewer proposals and explicit approval, and an approved-version rehearsal/observation loop. Preserve existing public journey/workshop/questionnaire exceptions and existing Anthropic and Studio behavior. This is local validation with the team flag off by default; real-provider staging and human educational quality evaluation remain pending.

evidence: Snapshot VM: edit purpose before reject -> original purpose, dirty:false, and no stored unsaved edit; existing 14 activity-flow tests pass. Validator independently reproduced loss of purpose and concerns on Node v20.19.1.
findings.first_evidence: app/lib/activity-review-ui.js:235 -- return adopt(result.artifact, revision, 'decision'); ; app/lib/activity-review-ui.js:141 -- state.draft = clone(artifact.content); state.concerns = artifact.privateConcerns || ''; state.dirty = false;
findings.suggested_fix: On reject, retain draft, concerns, dirty state and local recovery if dirty when the request began; update only artifact/proposal metadata. Keep the revision guard for edits during the request. Test edit-before-reject and edit-during-reject.
findings.title: Rejecting a proposal erases unsaved human edits
findings.why_it_matters: Reject remains enabled after an edit. Its response adopts old server content and private concerns, clears dirty, and replaces local recovery. A reproduced edit-before-reject therefore loses both visible and recoverable human work.
findings.validation_reason: At reviewed head 7524755, activity-review-ui.js:228-235 and :140-144 adopt unchanged server content after an allowed dirty-draft rejection, and an independent Node v20.19.1 in-memory edit-before-reject reproduction erased both unsaved purpose and concerns, cleared dirty, and removed the edit from local storage; the newly added reject UI at :381 makes this ordering reachable.

evidence: Snapshot reproductions: retained abandoned claim blocks retry/approval with 409 review_running; a fresh successful review still cannot permit approval. Injecting one result compareAndSet exception returns 503 artifact_error and leaves the same running claim. Worker death after claim is another reachable sequence; production incidence unmeasured.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist artifact/version/run and attempt/lease ownership on jobs and claims. Atomically terminate or reclaim the matching claim after execution/storage failure or confirmed lost/expired work, preserving successful results. Fence abandoned attempts before appends/final writes, permit explicit retry and count only live runs at approval. Test restart and result-write failure through retry/approval.
findings.title: Reconcile artifact reviews when their worker is lost
findings.why_it_matters: A worker restart or reviewer-result storage exception leaves an artifact claim running without a lease or owning job link. Separate job/quota recovery cannot clear it: retry and approval return review_running, even after another review succeeds.
findings.validation_reason: New activity-artifact.mjs:134-135 persists a running claim before execution, while append exceptions bypass :148 and server lost-job recovery at practice-server.mjs:167-169 touches only pj records; an independent Node v20.19.1 snapshot reproduction with a single append-storage exception left the run running, returned 409 on retry and approval, and still blocked approval after a fresh successful review, establishing reachable failure without measuring production incidence.

evidence: Actual snapshot request listener with atomic memory store and synthetic provider: revoke STAFF111 during held resilience_facilitation, then release. Live principal:null, job:error, all three specialist plus synthesis calls/proposals persist, artifact review:complete.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass assertCurrent into artifact execution: resolve the original token and require current matching owner/tenant/permission plus a running, unexpired, unaborted job. findings.title: CWE-863: Revocation misses reviewer calls and persisted proposals
findings.why_it_matters: Revocation during a blocked artifact reviewer does not prevent subsequent proposal writes or synthesis calls. Live permission is checked only after handleArtifacts finishes, leaving a completed artifact review even though its job fails authorization.
findings.validation_reason: practice-server.mjs:110 runs the new artifact flow with a captured principal and only revalidates at :135-137 after proposal writes and synthesis, while activity-artifact.mjs:65-70 checks stored ownership rather than live permission; an independent Node v20.19.1 in-process snapshot route test revoked STAFF111 during a blocked reviewer, observed a null live principal, then still persisted that reviewer and synthesis and completed the artifact review while the job became error.
